_source: Section 10 of 01.projects/03.no-mans-sky/24.storage-guide.md in the Suika Box vault, 'A layout to start from'. The guide names a handful of items per container; the rules below extend each container to the families those items belong to, matched on the game's own subtitle and type. Rules are tried top to bottom and the first match wins, so the guide's named items come first and the broad families last. Anything no rule matches goes to 9 - Inbox, which is the guide's answer for an item you have not decided about yet. Hand-written, like acquisition.json: change the layout here.

exosuit.name: Exosuit
exosuit.note: You use it every few minutes, so it stays in the backpack.

0.name: Raw - common
0.note: Mined everywhere, used by almost every recipe. Lowest number, so stray duplicates come back here.

1.name: Raw - planetary
1.note: Biome-locked plants, minerals and gases; the crop and extractor inputs.

2.name: Refined
2.note: Refiner outputs. Keep a stock and you rarely refine on demand.

3.name: Components
3.note: Craft in bulk once, pull when building or repairing.

4.name: Production chain
4.note: The money engine's intermediates and finished goods. Sell the finished ones in batches.

5.name: Progression
5.note: Unlock currencies. Rare, never sold, always in one place.

6.name: Upgrades & tech
6.note: Uninstalled modules waiting for a slot, or for scrapping into nanites.

7.name: Sellables
7.note: Units waiting to happen. Empty it at a terminal when it fills.

8.name: Collectables
8.note: Display pieces and keepsakes. Move them to a fleet ship once they outgrow 50 slots.

9.name: Inbox
9.note: Not sorted yet. Give it a home, then every later one routes there by itself.

processor.name: Nutrient Processor
processor.note: 50 food slots that cost no cargo.

exocraft.name: Exocraft cargo
exocraft.note: Vehicle spares stay with the vehicles.

none.name: Nowhere
none.note: It should not take up a slot at all.
